_comment: Hesai PandarXT-32 calibration shimmed into Ouster JSON schema for COIN-LIO. PandarXT-32 has 32 channels uniformly spaced 1 deg apart from +15 to -16 deg, 10 Hz with 0.18 deg horizontal resolution => 2000 columns per frame. beam_altitude_angles is ordered top->bottom (ring 0 = topmost). The repack script sorts/reassigns ring indices to match this ordering. pixel_shift_by_row left as zeros because PandarXT-32 fires all channels per column simultaneously (no inter-channel azimuth offset).
